body: Paramjit Singh Soni (Promoter, Executive Director & Vice-Chairman) on the Q1FY25 call (2024-08-09), prompted: "the second half would be higher than half 1. And with quarter 4, I expect to have the highest run rate" Metric: Quarterly revenue shape FY25. Target: H2 > H1; Q4 highest quarter. Deadline: 2025-03-31 (quarter). Specificity: range. Status as of 2026-11-19: MOVED-GOALPOST. Evidence: H1 FY25 = 261+241 = INR 502 cr; H2 = 208+253 = INR 461 cr (-8%). Q4 INR 253 cr < Q1 INR 261 cr. On 2025-02-07 the guide became 'between Q1 and Q2', and when asked the promoter said: 'somebody asked me, is it going to be the highest? I said no', although on 2024-08-09 and 2024-11-08 management had said Q4 would be the highest. Management explanation: Repeated in Nov-2024 (softened to 'H2 flattish over H1'), then missed.

This thing is to stay at about a 15% to 16% growth" Metric: Revenue CAGR through the cycle. Target: 15-16% p.a. vs end-market 5-6%. Deadline: 2029-03-31 (vague). Specificity: range. Status as of 2026-11-19: PENDING. Evidence: Unscorable yet. FY23-FY26 revenue CAGR is -5% (1,366 to 1,170); TTM +33%. Needs a full cycle (FY23 peak to next peak).
